provenance.procedure: GET /search/movie?query=Totally+Unknown+Film&page=1 with an Authorization: Bearer <v4 read access token>; synthesised from the published TMDB v3 contract (ADR-0026) because CI has no token and none may be committed. Regenerate against a real token with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tmdb search-movie-unknown.
provenance.note: Synthesised: TMDB knows nothing by this name. An empty results array is the modelled 'nothing matched' outcome, which the client must report as found=false with no error so the worker backs the Work off rather than retrying.
